body:
noah_sales: Heads up  LumaBank wants a quick POC next Thurs. Ask: +5 GPUs ephemeral for 2 hours (heavy embeddings). Can we?

arvind_eng: Yes. Prefer burst credits (no commit). Need exact UTC window and whether they need custom KMS.

noah_sales: Window 2025-02-20 15:00-17:00 UTC. They said they can do ephemeral keys for demo; KMS later.

lina_sre: For ephemeral: we need their public IP ranges to allow control-plane callbacks. Also specify cooldown (default 30m ok?)

noah_sales: IP blocks: 52.12.34.0/24. Cooldown 30m is fine. Procurement asks about uplift.

revops-bot: Policy: Ephemeral burst billed at list + 22% uplift. If they sign reserved within 30 days, apply retro credit up to uplift. Promo credit must be approved by RevOps.

noah_sales: I'll request a small promo. Can ops create ticket with metadata?

ops-bot: Ticket POC-6210 created. Metadata: ephemeral_burst=5; window=[2025-02-20T15:00Z/2025-02-20T17:00Z]; cooldown=30m; ip_allowlist=[52.12.34.0/24]; billing_code=LUMA-E2E. Assignee: arvind_eng.

arvind_eng: Taking it. Plan: 1) allocate ephemeral headroom 2) issue scoped API key and upload to ticket 3) route embeddings to quantized variant luma-embed-q2 during burst to save cost 4) add warm-up 15m before window.

lina_sre: I'll prepare minimal allowlist doc and note about KMS onboarding lead time (2w).

arvind_eng: Done  pool up, scoped key uploaded to POC-6210. Warm-up scheduled. Monitoring panel added.

noah_sales: Amazing, thanks team :tada:
